_comment: Campus landmarks. Footprint positions come from OpenStreetMap (real buildings at Jessup University, Rocklin). The NAMES are representative campus buildings chosen to match each footprint's size and position - they are not the actual Jessup building names. Rename freely - see _editing below.

_editing.why: Routing keys off 'id' and the graph node each landmark snaps to. 'name' and 'color' are display-only. Changing them needs no rebuild of the graph - though re-running scripts/build-graph.mjs will carry the new values into campus.json. Entries flagged 'invented' have no OSM feature behind them at all - their coordinates were chosen to sit beside the path network. Move or delete them freely.
_editing.hintField: 'hint' describes each building's real position and size on campus, so you can match a name to the right physical building. Entries with an 'osmType'/'kind' field are real named or typed OSM features, not representative guesses.

_source.note: 11 building footprints are tagged building=yes with no name in OSM (ordered north to south). The 3 non-building places added later - Crossroads Cafe, Main Parking, Sports Field - DO carry their real OSM tags and names.

landmarks.name: Security Kiosk
landmarks.hint: Northernmost building. Very small (~110 m2) - fits a gatehouse or kiosk.

landmarks.name: Campus Store
landmarks.hint: North end, easternmost building on campus. Small (~193 m2).

landmarks.name: Science Hall
landmarks.hint: North cluster, west side. Medium (~691 m2).

landmarks.name: Art Studio
landmarks.hint: North cluster, east side. Smaller (~381 m2).

landmarks.name: Student Center
landmarks.hint: Dead centre of campus. Medium (~657 m2).

landmarks.name: Administration
landmarks.hint: Central-west, westernmost building. Large (~1350 m2). Oldest OSM record on campus.

landmarks.name: Lecture Halls
landmarks.hint: Largest footprint on campus (~1511 m2), south-central.

landmarks.name: Chapel
landmarks.hint: South end of the main cluster, west side. Small (~218 m2).

landmarks.name: Gymnasium
landmarks.hint: Roughly 250 m south of the main cluster - the isolated position fits an athletics facility.

landmarks.name: Crossroads Cafe
landmarks.hint: REAL OSM name. Jessup dining, 2121 University Avenue. Mo-Fr 07:30-19:00, Sa-Su 10:30-18:30. North-west of the main cluster.

landmarks.name: Main Parking
landmarks.hint: REAL OSM feature. The large east lot (~4.5 ha) - by far the biggest area on campus. Position is the lot centroid.

landmarks.name: Sports Field
landmarks.hint: REAL OSM feature. Pitch on the west side (~1 ha). Position is the pitch centroid.

landmarks.name: Dorm A
landmarks.hint: INVENTED position - OpenStreetMap maps no dormitories at Jessup. Placed beside the south-east path corridor, ~360 m from the main cluster.

landmarks.name: Dorm B
landmarks.hint: INVENTED position - see Dorm A. ~49 m south-west of Dorm A.

landmarks.name: Dorm C
landmarks.hint: INVENTED position - see Dorm A. ~37 m south-west of Dorm B, nearest of the three to the Gymnasium.
